title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Premium Owed on a Cover
content:
The premium owed on a cover of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` depends on whether and when the cover was bound, and on what has been charged to it afterwards.

## Scope

This reckoning of premium owed concerns premium payable after binding. Prepaid premium, which a tier with compulsory prepayment requires from a cash-in-advance holder before the cover is in force, is outside it.

## Definition

- **No binding date.** Within this reckoning, a cover never bound has no binding date and nothing is owed on it: its premium owed stands at 0.00.
- **The binding day.** On the day of binding, the amount owed equals the premium the tier produces on the value at which the cover was bound. That premium is formed as a premium charge is formed: the bound value multiplied by the tier's premium rate, the goods-category uplift applied to that product, then, where the holder's active service contract reaches the tier's qualifying rank, the contract discount applied to the uplifted figure, then lifted to the tier's minimum premium where it falls below it, with a single rounding to the cent at the end. The two figures coincide, since a premium charge entered on the binding day is built in exactly this way from exactly these records.
- **Later days.** After the binding day, the amount owed is the total of every premium charge entered on the cover.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

| Cover's binding date | Date of the question | Premium charges booked on the cover (USD) | Premium owed (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| none, cover still quoted | any | none | 0.00 |
| 10 June | 10 June | none | the premium the tier yields on the bound value |
| 10 June | 10 June | 280.50 | the premium the tier yields on the bound value, which is that same 280.50 |
| 10 June | 25 June | 280.50 | 280.50 |
